scope: Independent native GetProcessTimes definitions are used by the tests. All children are newly created direct base-Python processes; no UCI game or user application was launched or terminated.
native_cases: self process raw counters independently bracketed
short one-thread child final held-process counters exact match
long two-thread child final held-process counters exact match
CloseHandle leaves a live child running until its normal requested exit

cleanup.evidence: Each owned child completed process.wait() with returncode 0 and a final held-handle GetProcessTimes identity/counter read. Only the intentionally live self process is excluded.

limitations: CPU counters are quantized; zero CPU is valid for immediate moves.
Search CPU covers only the selected endpoint process and all of its threads, excluding descendants.
CPU/wall ratios are diagnostics and have no minimum-utilization pass criterion.
Self-read is compared to independently queried before/after counters; final exited-child counters match exactly.
